description:
Privacy-first screenshot OCR and translation desktop tool

PingYi captures a selected screen region, recognizes its text, and translates it in a compact result card. It supports fully local OCR and translation, local LLM services such as llama.cpp and Ollama, and optional Google Cloud or Baidu providers using credentials supplied by the user. The default local workflow keeps screenshots and text on the device and does not retain a history.
截屏释义 v0.10.2

更新
- 改进版本构建和发布流程，核验最终安装包后公开为正式 Release。
- 保留源码与安装包敏感信息扫描、依赖和许可证检查、SHA-256 校验及已发布文件保护。
- 沿用 v0.10.1 的截图启动性能优化；没有修改应用行为、本地配置或 API Key 存储方式。

下载
Windows 使用 PingYi-Complete-0.10.2-win-x64-setup.exe，另提供便携 ZIP；Linux 提供 DEB 和 tar.gz。升级前请完全退出旧版及其托盘进程。
